anchors.quote:
3.3 “Net assets” refers to the value that is calculated by deducting total liabilities from total
assets. “Net assets, excluding primary residence” refers to the value that is calculated
by deducting the value of primary residence from net assets.

assumptions: The supplied assets include the supplied primary residence value, as specified by the interface.
Input classification, account ownership and conversion to HKD are supplied outside this calculation.
Signed monetary inputs are admitted for arithmetic stress tests, as expressly requested; no nonnegative floor is applied.
value.interpretation: Compute net assets by subtracting total liabilities from total assets, then subtract the primary residence value. This implements only paragraph 3.3's arithmetic and makes no SPI eligibility determination.
